Name: Barachel
Summary: Barachel the Buzite was the father of Elihu, named in Job as Elihu is introduced before his speeches.
KeyStory: Barachel himself speaks no words in the book; he is known only as Elihu's father, of the kindred of Ram.
LifeLesson: Even a one-line mention in Scripture counts: Barachel's son spoke truth, and a father's name is preserved with it.
